annotations.title: Text to speech API, TTS: natural voices, MP3 audio from text

description: Text to speech API: turn up to 300 characters of text into natural, human-sounding speech as an MP3 (base64) with Deepgram Aura-2 voices, in English (40 voices) or Spanish (10). Pick a voice by name or keep the default. Use for voice replies, narration, audio notes, IVR prompts and accessibility. Example: text=Your payment was received. Thank you!. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits); failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
